messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: CmdStan 2.6.0 is now up.
parts:
I'm going to announce Stan and CmdStan 2.6.0.

R, Python, Matlab, Julia... when you're ready, we can announce the release of those packages too.



Daniel

messages.author: 512610f4917ceaf3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] CmdStan 2.6.0 is now up.
parts:
Hi Daniel,

Just installed and tried Stan 2.6.0. It runs fine under Julia-0.3.5 and the current version of Stan.jl. I don’t think any changes are needed for Stan.jl.

If users run into issues with any of the new features I will look into those, but nothing jumped out from your v2.6.0 updates list that affects Stan.jl.

I really like that Stan itself is back inside CmdStan!

I’ll wait a few days and then will ask Tanmay if he would be willing to update Stan on JuliaBox.

Great job this roll-out!

Regards,
Rob J. Goedman
goe...@mac.com
